F1: The optimized paginator applies math.floor/ceil directly to AuditLogEntry.datetime, crashing non-empty pages.
F2: Org-token authentication supplies an anonymous user with no membership, so the unconditional member dereference crashes authorized requests.
F3: Client-supplied negative offsets reach a Django QuerySet slice, which rejects negative indexing.
F4: Clamping an invalid next-cursor offset changes behavior but does not itself establish a behavioral defect.
F5: Nonzero cursor values are bound as numbers in comparisons against the datetime column instead of being converted to datetimes.
F6: The role-gated branch passes unvalidated negative offsets into ORM slicing, causing a crash rather than a validation error.
